reasoning_content: Root returns 307 (redirect to domain presumably). Let's follow redirect. Also check app domain. Let's check /api/globals and health. Also try seeding prototype data since guide mentions seed:prototype and demo accounts. The guide's setup section only requires the compose up + health. But to be thorough, we could run seed.
